name: Dobrovij
description: Deity of goodness, kindness, and moral virtue. Divine endorsement of generosity and right action.
mythology: Dobrovij (The Good One) is a benevolent deity of goodness, kindness, and moral virtue. His name derives from 'dobro' — the Slavic root for goodness, one of the most positively charged words in Slavic moral philosophy (common across all Slavic languages). He represents the principle that good actions have divine backing and that virtue is witnessed and rewarded by higher powers. He is invoked when making vows of generosity and when seeking blessings for acts of kindness. As a spiritual counterpoint to Chernobog, he embodies positive divine force without the martial aggression of warrior deities — a divine endorsement of everyday human goodness, community, and generosity.

offerings: Acts of kindness performed in his honor
